summary: This May 5 Piers Morgan interview extends the Chokepoint/Strategy and Prediction surfaces by turning Hormuz disruption into a production-system, water, fertilizer, energy, money-trust, and technology-transition fork rather than a simple oil-price shock.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public read marks the Strait shock as physical production collapse: helium, fertilizer, sulfuric acid, energy, water, and manufacturing fail before markets finish repricing the event.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing Chokepoint anchor owns the material platform that cheap energy, fertilizer, food, water, AI infrastructure, and modern consumption require.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Hormuz is treated as a control surface where military access, global production, Gulf desalination, China exposure, and political voting cycles become one board.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source repeats the public systems-pivot mechanism, with water/desalination and production inputs giving the recurrence sharper everyday-life pressure.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang warns that provocation or a Gulf-of-Tonkin-style incident can convert duration pressure into ground-invasion justification.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The no-exit war page already owns escalation that becomes easier to continue than to stop once credibility, optics, and chokepoint pressure compound.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Trump is described as wanting to be the centre of attention, making spectacle and attention-seeking a strategic variable in escalation risk.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Prediction and Game Theory own the audit of visible theater when a leader's performed incentives can forecast the next move; Attention owns only broader consciousness capture.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as the May 5 public-panel recurrence where Hormuz becomes production-system collapse rather than ordinary energy inflation: helium, fertilizer, sulfur chemistry, desalination, and manufacturing inputs make the strait a civilizational infrastructure test.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Chokepoint owns the access-control and cheap-energy platform. Strategy parent owns the general material audit; Prediction owns dated depression or escalation claims; Civilization/Borderland should receive energy-transition evidence only if the public concept is being revised around renewal capacity.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add to the forecast comparison set, not directly to the ledger: on 2026-05-05 Jiang frames a global depression risk around sustained Strait disruption, a possible Gulf-of-Tonkin provocation path to ground invasion, a five-year climate/energy sliding-door test, and a ten-to-twenty-percent energy-decline-to-GDP contraction claim.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns the dated forecast family and later scoring. Chokepoint owns the mechanism that makes the forecast plausible. Do not promote these claims until compared against March-April 2026 Hormuz and energy-reversal forecast records.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the money section only as secondary Power evidence if the page is being revised: Jiang rejects commodity-money simplification, defines money as a promise/credit relation, and criticizes Bitcoin as store-of-value adoption rather than general exchange.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy owns money as promise, trust, and symbolic reality. Secret Society owns Bitcoin only when Jiang foregrounds hidden builder, cover story, laundering, or surveillance; this source is about monetary function, not covert origin.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the final technology fork as possible renewal evidence: Jiang accepts a future of technological plenty only if energy constraints and climate catastrophe are crossed, and he names China as the leading self-sufficiency and energy-technology case.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Civilization or Borderland may own renewal capacity when the active mechanism is technological adaptation and self-sufficiency. Chokepoint owns the energy bottleneck; Prediction owns the dated five-year sliding-door claim.

new_lens_seeds.title: Energy Reversal As De-Industrialization
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A modern economy that treats energy as background abundance discovers that labor, capital, food, water, logistics, and technology are inert when the energy platform breaks.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This source adds memorable production-system and energy-corpse/sculpture formulations to the existing March seed, connecting Hormuz, fertilizer, desalination, manufacturing, climate, technology, and GDP contraction.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as the same seed already raised by the March 11 Dore source, not a new page. Promote only after a concept-scoped energy-reversal review proves the mechanism exceeds Chokepoint and Strategy.

chronology_notes.note: This 2026-05-05 interview is a late public-panel recurrence after the March-April Iran-war/Hormuz cluster; its value is not origin status but sharper production-system, water, fertilizer, and technology-fork language.

The source adds a May 2026 forecast-comparison node: global depression risk from sustained Hormuz disruption, escalation through a provocation or Gulf-of-Tonkin incident, a five-year climate/energy test, and a quantitative energy-to-GDP contraction claim.

The money and Bitcoin passage should be routed as money-function evidence, not the covert Bitcoin-origin seed: Jiang defines money as a promise/credit relation and criticizes Bitcoin's adoption limits as store-of-value behavior.

canon_candidates.candidate: May 5, 2026 forecast comparison for global depression and energy-contraction risk under sustained Hormuz disruption.
canon_candidates.reason: The source gives a dated public forecast family with concrete mechanisms: production-system input loss, market underreaction, provocation/escalation risk, and a ten-to-twenty-percent energy decline mapped to GDP contraction.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare against the March 11 energy-reversal forecast, April 21 ceasefire/energy-infrastructure forecast, April 24 chokepoint-control impact, and any later source that revises the Hormuz closure premise before ledger promotion.
